subject: Bounded Language 1 front-door development checkpoint
claim: The bounded language front-door checkpoint passed its frozen-fixture, descriptor, and value-front-end phases and reported 329 development cases locally and on GitHub-hosted Windows and Linux. Exact committed owner execution took 200,727 ms on Windows and 172,336 ms on Linux. The no-argument 492-case qualification path was not executed by these runs.
limitations: This is one observation per CI host plus one local Windows observation, not a stable performance threshold.
The run used the host's existing valid native development caches where the invoked producers permit them; it is not a clean-machine timing.
The 163 qualification-only cases after phase 3 were intentionally not executed, and this result cannot support a Qualified claim.
The CI jobs restored valid development checkpoints before execution; these are development-path measurements, not clean-machine qualification timings.
The historical 2,761,285 ms complete-owner timing came from GitHub Actions run 33894696448 at an earlier qualified source commit and is used only as a baseline comparison.
